content: Customer Reyansh Tiwari called insurance agent Anjali Desai to verify policy details. They discussed the policy expiration date (30 September 2027), the $2,500 deductible, $150 monthly premium, and how claims work prior to meeting the deductible. The agent confirmed that tele-consultation covers mental health specialists and explained the cancellation process (30-day notice for a prorated refund). The agent also reminded the customer to keep documents accessible and submit claims within 90 days.
